system.description:
Once a fight, you can put real weight behind a casting — enough that whoever's on the receiving end finds their usual resistance isn't there when they need it most. Once per encounter, when you cast a spell, the target(s) have Disadvantage on their saving throw against it.

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.

rules.value: Potent Casting: once per encounter, targets have Disadvantage on their save against this spell.
